tools.name: add_features
tools.description: Add features to a vector layer. Each feature: {attributes: {field: value}, geometry_wkt: 'POINT(1 2)'}. geometry_wkt is in the layer's CRS, or in crs when given (it is then reprojected). A geometry type the layer cannot hold is refused; invalid geometry or 2D on a Z layer comes back in warnings. Returns count of added features.

tools.name: add_field
tools.description: Add a new field to a vector layer. field_type: 'string', 'int', 'double', 'bool', 'date', 'datetime'.

tools.name: add_raster_layer
tools.description: Add a raster layer (GeoTIFF, etc.) to the project.

tools.name: add_table_join
tools.description: Add a table join to a vector layer.

tools.name: add_vector_layer
tools.description: Add a vector layer (shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, etc.) to the project.

tools.name: apply_style_qml
tools.description: Apply a QGIS QML style to a layer, from a file (path) or inline QML text (qml); pass exactly one. Use it for styles the other styling tools do not model (rule-based renderers, data-defined properties, SVG fills, blend modes). Rejected, with the previous style restored, if the XML is malformed, targets the other layer kind, or QGIS loads a different renderer than the QML declares. Tip: save_style_qml on a similar layer gives a template in this QGIS version's format.

tools.name: commit_edits
tools.description: Commit the layer's edit buffer to the data source and close the edit session.

tools.name: create_checkpoint
tools.description: Snapshot the whole project (layers, styles, labels, layouts, map themes, variables, and the features of memory layers) so restore_checkpoint can return to it. Take one before a sequence of changes you may want to undo. The user's project file is not touched. Data in files and databases is not copied, and uncommitted edits are listed under 'uncommitted_edits' because the checkpoint does not hold them. The last 20 are kept, until the plugin's server stops.

tools.name: create_layer_group
tools.description: Create a new layer group in the layer tree. Optionally specify a parent group name.

tools.name: create_memory_layer
tools.description: Create a new in-memory vector layer. geometry_type: Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, MultiPolygon. fields: [{name, type}] where type is integer, double, string, date, datetime.

tools.name: delete_features
tools.description: Delete features by feature IDs or expression filter. Provide either fids (list of ints) or expression (string), not both. Returns requested and the measured deleted count.

tools.name: delete_field
tools.description: Delete a field from a vector layer.

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: Run diagnostic checks on the QGIS MCP stack. Reports QGIS version, plugin/server version match, processing providers, connected clients, and project status.

tools.name: execute_processing
tools.description: Execute a QGIS Processing algorithm. Use get_algorithm_help to discover parameters. Layer params accept layer IDs or file paths. Set OUTPUT to 'memory:' for temp layers. timeout: seconds before the algorithm is cancelled (default 55). Raise it for heavy raster work, or use start_processing_job, which runs in the background with no limit. load_results: add the algorithm's outputs to the project and list them in 'loaded_layers' (the processing.runAndLoadResults() behaviour). This is the only way to keep a 'TEMPORARY_OUTPUT'/'memory:' result, which is otherwise discarded when the run ends. Only vector and raster destinations are loaded, never file or folder ones. ellipsoid: ellipsoid for distance/area measurements (e.g. 'EPSG:7030' for WGS 84, 'NONE' for planimetric). Default is the open project's ellipsoid.

tools.name: field_calculator
tools.description: Add (if missing) + populate a field from a QGIS expression, per feature, in-place. field_type: string|int|double|bool|date|datetime (default double). Example: expression='$area', field_name='area'. $area/$length use the project's ellipsoid and units (reported back as 'measurement'), not necessarily m2/m; the area()/length() functions are planimetric in the layer CRS (measurement.planimetric_units, squared for area()); length() of a string counts characters and reports no units. Returns updated and failed counts; failed features keep their old value and first_error says why. Refused while the layer has an open edit session.

tools.name: find_layer
tools.description: Find layers by name pattern. Supports fnmatch wildcards (e.g. 'roads*') and substring matching.

tools.name: get_active_layer
tools.description: Get the currently active (selected) layer in the QGIS layer panel.

tools.name: get_algorithm_help
tools.description: Get detailed help for a processing algorithm: parameters (name, type, optional, default), outputs, and description.

tools.name: get_bookmarks
tools.description: Get spatial bookmarks from the project. Each bookmark has a name, group, extent (xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax), and CRS.

tools.name: get_canvas_extent
tools.description: Get the current map canvas extent and CRS.

tools.name: get_canvas_scale
tools.description: Get the current map canvas scale, rotation, and magnification factor.

tools.name: get_edit_status
tools.description: Edit state of a layer: editable, modified, undo/redo availability, and the counts of pending added/deleted/changed features.

tools.name: get_field_statistics
tools.description: Compute aggregate statistics (count, sum, mean, min, max, stdev) for a numeric field. For non-numeric fields returns count and distinct values.

tools.name: get_layer_crs
tools.description: Get the coordinate reference system (CRS) of a layer: EPSG code, description, whether geographic, and PROJ4 string.

tools.name: get_layer_extent
tools.description: Get the spatial extent (bounding box) and CRS of a layer.

tools.name: get_layer_features
tools.description: Get features from a vector layer. Flat dicts: _fid + attributes at top level. expression filter (QGIS, e.g. "name = 'Berlin'", "population > 1000000"), limit (max 50, larger is refused; default 10), offset for paging, optional geometry in _geometry key. feature_count is the layer total; matched is the count after the expression filter.

tools.name: get_layer_labeling
tools.description: Get the labeling configuration of a vector layer: enabled state, field, font size, color.

tools.name: get_layer_tree
tools.description: Get the full layer tree structure with groups and layers. Returns recursive tree with type, name, visibility, and children.

tools.name: get_layers
tools.description: List layers in the current project with IDs, names, types, visibility, and type-specific info. Use limit/offset for pagination. Response includes total_count.

tools.name: get_layout_info
tools.description: List items in a print layout (type, id, uuid, position, size) and page count.

tools.name: get_map_themes
tools.description: Get map themes (visibility presets). Each theme stores which layers are visible.

tools.name: get_message_log
tools.description: Get QGIS message log entries. Filter by level ('info', 'warning', 'critical', 'success', 'none') and/or tag (e.g. 'QGIS MCP'). Returns newest first.

tools.name: get_plugin_info
tools.description: Get detailed info for a specific plugin: name, enabled, version, description, author, path.

tools.name: get_processing_job
tools.description: State of a background job: 'running' (with progress 0-100), 'succeeded' (with result, loaded_layers and warnings, as execute_processing returns them), 'failed' (with error) or 'cancelled'. Omit job_id to list every job.

tools.name: get_processing_providers
tools.description: List Processing providers (native, gdal, grass, saga, model, ...) with algorithm counts and active status. Use to diagnose missing algorithms.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Get current project metadata: filename, title, CRS, layer count, and summary of layers.

tools.name: get_project_variables
tools.description: Get all project-level variables (key-value pairs set in Project Properties).

tools.name: get_qgis_info
tools.description: Get QGIS version, profile path, and plugin count.

tools.name: get_raster_info
tools.description: Get raster layer info: band count, dimensions, CRS, extent, per-band statistics, nodata values.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get the current selection for a layer. Returns feature IDs and count.

tools.name: get_setting
tools.description: Read a QGIS setting by key path (e.g. 'qgis/sketching/sketching_enabled').

tools.name: get_unique_values
tools.description: Return the distinct values of a field. Use 'limit' to cap results (-1 for all). Useful before building categorized symbology or filters.

tools.name: identify_features
tools.description: Identify features at a point [x, y] across layers (map-click analogue). The point and tolerance are in crs when given, else the project CRS; layers in another CRS are reprojected. tolerance (in those units) expands the search; 0 = exact hit. layer_ids limits the search (default: visible vector layers). limit caps features per layer. Layers the point cannot be transformed into are listed in skipped_layers.

tools.name: list_checkpoints
tools.description: List the project checkpoints: id, name, creation time, layer count.

tools.name: list_connection_tables
tools.description: List tables reachable through a saved connection. On providers with schemas (PostgreSQL), omit schema to get the schema list first, then pass one. Returns each table's geometry column, CRS, primary key and kind.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the data source connections saved in QGIS (PostgreSQL, GeoPackage, SpatiaLite, MS SQL, Oracle, ...) - the Browser panel entries. Optionally filter by provider (e.g. 'postgres', 'ogr', 'spatialite'). Passwords are redacted from the URIs.

tools.name: list_layouts
tools.description: List all print layouts in the current project with names and page counts.

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.description: List installed QGIS plugins with name, enabled status, and version. Set enabled_only=true to list only active plugins.

tools.name: list_processing_algorithms
tools.description: Search for processing algorithms by keyword and/or provider. Returns id, name, provider for each match.

tools.name: list_processing_models
tools.description: List registered Processing models (the 'model' provider). Returns id, name, group for each. Use run_model to execute one.

tools.name: list_qgis_instances
tools.description: List the configured QGIS instances: name, host, port, reachability, and - for each reachable one - which QGIS actually answered (version, process id, window title, profile). Use it to confirm a name maps to the window you mean before writing to it. Pass a name as the 'instance' argument of any other tool to target that QGIS window; omitting it targets the instance named 'default', or the first one listed when no instance is called 'default'.

tools.name: move_layer_to_group
tools.description: Move a layer into a layer group by group name.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check connectivity to the QGIS plugin server. Returns pong if connected.

tools.name: raster_calculator
tools.description: Band math via the QGIS raster calculator. Reference loaded raster layers in the expression as 'LayerName@band' (e.g. '("dem@1" > 1000) * 1'). Writes a GeoTIFF to output_path. Output grid, extent and CRS taken from reference_layer (layer id or name), defaulting to the first loaded file-based raster.

tools.name: remove_layer
tools.description: Remove a layer from the project by its layer ID. This is irreversible.

tools.name: rename_field
tools.description: Rename a field in a vector layer.

tools.name: restore_checkpoint
tools.description: Put the project back as it was at a checkpoint: every change since, and any uncommitted edit, is discarded. The project keeps its file name and is left unsaved. Memory layer features come back with new feature ids. Layers whose source is missing are kept as unavailable and listed in 'unavailable_layers'. export_session afterwards replays the restored state, not the undone steps.

tools.name: rollback_edits
tools.description: Discard every uncommitted change on a layer and close the edit session.

tools.name: sample_raster_values
tools.description: Sample raster pixel values at points. 'points' is a list of [x, y] in crs when given (reprojected to the raster), else in the raster's CRS. Omit 'band' to sample all bands. A null value is nodata when outside_extent is false; outside_extent true means the point is off the raster (often a CRS mix-up); transform_failed marks a point the raster's CRS cannot express.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the current project. Optionally specify a new path.

tools.name: select_features
tools.description: Select features in a layer by expression or feature IDs.

tools.name: set_active_layer
tools.description: Set the active layer in the QGIS layer panel by layer ID.

tools.name: set_layer_crs
tools.description: Set the CRS of a layer (e.g. 'EPSG:4326'). This does NOT reproject data - it only changes how the layer's coordinates are interpreted.

tools.name: set_layer_labeling
tools.description: Configure labeling for a vector layer. Set enabled=false to disable labels. Set field_name to the attribute field to label with. Optional: font_size (float), color (hex like '#000000').

tools.name: set_layer_order
tools.description: Reorder layer tree nodes; tree order is draw order. layer_ids is the ordered list of layer ids from top (drawn last) to bottom; unlisted layers keep their slots. Clears any custom draw order (it freezes a snapshot list - layers added later would silently draw behind everything).

tools.name: set_layer_property
tools.description: Set a layer property. Supported properties: opacity (0.0-1.0), name (string), min_scale, max_scale (float), scale_visibility (bool).

tools.name: set_layer_style
tools.description: Set symbology. style_type: 'single' (one symbol), 'categorized' (unique values), 'graduated' (numeric ranges). field required for categorized/graduated. color_ramp: QGIS ramp name (e.g. 'Spectral', 'Viridis', 'Blues'). classes: graduated class count (default 5).

tools.name: set_layer_visibility
tools.description: Set a layer's visibility in the layer tree (show/hide on map).

tools.name: set_project_crs
tools.description: Set the project coordinate reference system (e.g. 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857'). This changes how layers are projected on the map canvas.

tools.name: set_raster_style
tools.description: Set raster symbology. style_type: 'singleband_pseudocolor' (color ramp over one band), 'singleband_gray', 'multiband_color' (RGB), 'hillshade'. min_value/max_value default to the band statistics. color_ramp: QGIS ramp name (e.g. 'Viridis', 'Spectral', 'RdYlGn'). classification: continuous|equal_interval|quantile. interpolation: interpolated|discrete|exact. gradient (gray): black_to_white|white_to_black. contrast: none|stretch|clip|stretch_clip. hillshade uses band, azimuth, altitude, z_factor.

tools.name: spatial_join
tools.description: Join attributes by location (native:joinattributesbylocation). predicates int list: 0=intersects 1=contains 2=equals 3=touches 4=overlaps 5=within 6=crosses (default [0]). method: 0=one-to-many 1=first match (default) 2=largest overlap. First match keeps one arbitrary match per target feature and drops the others; use 0 when several can match. join_fields = copied columns (default all). No output_path = in-memory layer. Returns joined_count (target features that found a match, whatever the method) next to target_features. warnings/warning_count report features QGIS skipped, e.g. invalid geometries under the Processing setting that skips them; fix them first (native:fixgeometries) or those features never match.

tools.name: start_editing
tools.description: Open an edit session on a vector layer. Subsequent add/update/delete calls go to the undoable edit buffer instead of the data source, until commit_edits or rollback_edits.

tools.name: transform_coordinates
tools.description: Transform coordinates between CRS. Accepts a point {x, y}, a point list [{x, y}, ...], or a bbox {xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax}. Returns the same format. x is always longitude/easting and y latitude/northing, including for EPSG:4326. A bbox that crosses the antimeridian comes back with xmin > xmax and crosses_antimeridian: true.

tools.name: undo_edits
tools.description: Undo the last edit operations on a layer (its own undo stack). Returns how many steps were actually undone.

tools.name: update_feature_geometry
tools.description: Replace feature geometries. updates: [{fid: 1, geometry_wkt: 'POINT(1 2)'}]. WKT must be in the layer's CRS. Inside an edit session the change is undoable; otherwise it is written straight to the data source.

tools.name: update_features
tools.description: Update feature attributes. updates: [{fid: 1, attributes: {field: value}}]. Returns count of updated features.

tools.name: validate_expression
tools.description: Validate a QGIS expression. Returns whether it's valid, any parse errors, and referenced column names. Optionally test against a layer's fields.

tools.name: zonal_statistics
tools.description: Per-polygon stats from a raster (native:zonalstatisticsfb). stats int codes: 0=count 1=sum 2=mean 3=median 4=stdev 5=min 6=max 7=range 8=minority 9=majority 10=variety 11=variance (default [0,1,2]). New columns prefixed by 'prefix'. No output_path = in-memory layer.
